issue_context.title: Bug: Files window doesn't focus when opened from another program
issue_context.body:
### Description

When I have launched the files app and I have a folder open, I minimize the interface and then I open a folder on the desktop, but the interface doesn't show up at the top, but I check and find that it does open the folder.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open folder a
2. Minimize the interface to the taskbar
3. Double-click to open another folder b
4. The software still appears in the taskbar, not at the top.
5. Check the software interface and find that folder b has been opened.

### Requirements

- e.g. Fix crash that occurs when...


### Files Version

3.3.0.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22635.3500

### Log File

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/15048370/debug.log)
comments:
Thank you for the feedback!

So, the issue you reported is where opening a folder doesn't bring the app window to the top foreground, where you can visually see? Or the app still minimized in your taskbar?
Yes, the folder is opened, but the software interface doesn't pop up and remains minimized in the taskbar.
